summary: Normalized 5 functional and 5 non-functional requirements; 8 ambiguities resolved by recorded decisions or conventional assumptions, 0 left open.
decisions: What event qualifies as a successful redirect and therefore a click?: Count a request when the existing service returns its successful redirect response; do not require confirmation that the visitor reached the destination. (assumption)

What route and response representation should the stats endpoint use, including the representation for a link that has never been clicked?: Use a GET stats subresource following the existing link route and API conventions. Return JSON with totalClicks as an integer, dailyClicks as an oldest-first array of objects containing date (YYYY-MM-DD) and clicks (integer), and lastClickedAt as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp or null when there have been no clicks. (assumption)

Does total clicks mean all clicks or only clicks within the returned daily-history window?: totalClicks is the lifetime count for the link; dailyClicks covers only the specified 30-day window. (assumption)

If click recording fails while a redirect is being handled, may the click be absent from stats?: The redirect must still return its existing successful response. Click recording is best-effort when its persistence operation fails, so that click may be absent from analytics. (assumption)
